title: GDF15 is a putative biomarker for distinguishing pulmonary veno-occlusive disease and pulmonary arterial hypertension
authors: Prabhakar A; De Bie EMDD; DesJardin JT; et al.
support_determination: Supports published source/cohort/biomarker/cutoff. The 81%/98% quotation concerns the source comparison; distinguish from 80.8%/97.1% in the restricted 166 cohort. Does not establish validity of all reanalysis rhetoric.
recommended_action: Add full title and explicit reference call; retain distinct published and recomputed intervals

title: Pulmonary veno-occlusive disease: a paradigm of diagnosis and therapeutic challenges in pulmonary hypertension
authors: Aguado B; Grynblat J; Budhram B; et al.
support_determination: Abstract supports rare disease diagnostic and therapeutic challenges and EIF2AK4 context. Full review text was not obtained; precise histological diagnostic wording is supported separately by guideline 4.
recommended_action: Add DOI; do not claim full-text verification of inaccessible review

title: The cost of dichotomising continuous variables
support_determination: Supports information loss and statistical costs of dichotomization. Does not prove the fitted GDF15 curve is individual truth or that all errors occur nearest the cutoff.

title: 2022 ESC/ERS Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary hypertension
authors: Humbert M; Kovacs G; Hoeper MM; et al.
support_determination: Supports PVOD/PCH diagnostic approach and pulmonary-oedema risk with PAH drugs; does not establish which guideline each historical cohort used or final blinding.
recommended_action: Retain; A4 and A5 remain pending

authors: Steyerberg EW; Harrell FE Jr; Borsboom GJ; Eijkemans MJC; Vergouwe Y; Habbema JDF
